prompt: Who is the first Republican president of the United States to serve non-consecutive terms?
answer: Donald Trump is the first Republican president to serve nonconsecutive terms. He served as the 45th president (2017–2021) and then as the 47th president beginning in 2025. He is the second president overall to do so, after Democrat Grover Cleveland.
